comparison_protocol.model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, same frozen model/runtime and common P0 across both policies
comparison_protocol.M0: P0 + one independent restart R; at most two model calls per task
comparison_protocol.M1: P0 + bounded CPU repair + at most one conditional model call F or R; at most two model calls per task
comparison_protocol.research_accounting: Share P0 across M0/M1. If M1 selects R, reuse the same eligible R call; if it selects F, research generates at most P0+R+F, three calls per task. Never charge shared P0 twice in the actual research ledger.
comparison_protocol.deployment_accounting: Each deployable policy has at most two model calls per task; report each policy total including its own P0. A research union of P0/R/F is not itself a deployable two-call policy.
comparison_protocol.query_handling: Generate and validate the program once per task and apply it to every original query input. Each policy uses its own frozen selector to fill at most two final attempts per query.
comparison_protocol.confirmation_rule: Freeze model, code, seeds, token/time limits, CPU repair bounds, conditional F/R routing, and both final selectors after D24; then evaluate M0/M1 on C24 exactly once. Final attempt selection must not use query gold.
